value.rationale: A canonical distance-transitive cubic graph has a published strong chromatic index seven but a direct maximum-class-size lower bound only six. The complete 84-element extremal orbit and 26-regular pure four-packing graph locate an exact structural obstruction: no five largest induced matchings are edge-disjoint and every smaller disjoint family extends to four. This is a natural complete finite classification of feasible largest coloring classes and explains why the elementary bound is strict. No general theorem is needed for that graph-specific structural gap to be meaningful.
